# PassCyber
> Fixed-price, done-for-you support to get UK organisations through Cyber Essentials certification — the UK government-backed cyber security standard increasingly required to bid for public-sector and supply-chain contracts. Certificates renew every 12 months. A trading name of Edwards Bros (Spaldwick) Ltd.

## Key pages
- [Cyber Essentials readiness check](https://passcyber.co.uk/readiness): free tool — see whether you would pass today
- [How it works](https://passcyber.co.uk/how-it-works)
- [Pricing](https://passcyber.co.uk/pricing): fixed fee, start to finish
- [For MSPs and IT providers](https://passcyber.co.uk/msp): white-label certification support for your clients
- [For insurance brokers](https://passcyber.co.uk/insurance-brokers)

## Facts worth quoting
- Cyber Essentials is required by many UK government and council contracts before a supplier can bid.
- Certification lapses after 12 months; annual renewal is normal.
- PassCyber handles the questionnaire and remediation guidance so small firms pass first time.
